result.brief: Two-storey private residential duplex in Ikoyi, Lagos measured from architecture-only IFC model. Construction is strip footings with concrete foundation walls, 193mm blockwork external and party walls with 92mm facing brickwork, rigid insulation and metal stud plus plasterboard lining internally, steel wide-flange beams supporting timber-joisted upper floor, with ceramic and wood floor finishes and plasterboard ceilings. The model contains architecture, footings and isolated steel beams only, with no roof build-up measured, no structural detailing or reinforcement, and no mechanical, electrical or plumbing services.

facts.frame: Steel wide-flange beams with timber-joisted upper floor on blockwork/brick walls and strip footings
facts.exclusions: Loose furniture procured by client; stair assembly members to avoid double count

result.review_summary: Takeoff captures substructure concrete, wall layers, windows, doors and finishes reasonably layer-by-layer but cannot be priced as a complete duplex. The roof is entirely unmeasured and held, services are absent, and key preliminaries and groundworks are not in the model. QS must resolve roof intent, stair double-count risk and services scope before BOQ issue.

questions.question: Finish Floor - Ceramic Tile (Slab, Ifc2x3_Duplex_Architecture.ifc) is billed layer by layer, but its 3mm Masonry - Grout is not billed: should it be?

1 of Party Wall - CMU Residential Unit Dimising Wall (WallStandardCase, Ifc2x3_Duplex_Architecture.ifc) have no quantities in the model and were measured from their 3D shape (m²): check one against the drawings.
No roof covering, structure, insulation, fascia or rainwater goods are measured - the only roof type was held. What is the roof construction and finish to be billed?
No MEP services are measured - no lighting/power points, sanitary ware, soil and waste, water supply, or AC. Is there a separate services design or should all services be provisional/excluded?
Staircase nr and stair flight nr both measured as 2nr - are L017 and L018 the same two flights double-counted?

External slab on grade 150mm thick with its own membrane and anti-termite treatment measured separately from main ground floor - what is this area (porch, patio, driveway) and its finish and edge detail?
1250 x 2010mm described as single-leaf flush door set is unusually wide for a single leaf - confirm if double door, sliding or two leaves?
External wall measured as five coincident 272m2 layers (blockwork, 41mm stud, insulation, brickwork, plasterboard) - confirm composite build-up, ties, cavity and mortar, and which face is external?
All windows, doors, rails and cabinets state frame/material/finish to be confirmed - confirm aluminium/timber/steel, glazing type and ironmongery schedule before pricing?
